---
title: "Compatibility and limits"
---

## Watch and recording

- Requires Connect IQ API 6.0.3. See `manifest.xml` for supported profiles, including D2 Mach 2 Pro. The D2 Mach 2 profile was unavailable in the SDK used for verification.
- Capture requires a supported microphone and audio format. The app tries mono Ogg/Opus at 16 kHz, then mono WAV/LPCM at 8 kHz.
- The default recording limit is one minute. Choose 10 seconds to 30 minutes, or no limit. The optional vibration comes up to 10 seconds before the end.
- The watch stores up to 40 notes in 4 KB chunks. On storage exhaustion or interruption, it keeps saved chunks and marks the note partial. Delete notes to free space.
- **Save location** is off by default. If the watch gets a usable GPS fix during recording, the HTTPS export includes `location` as `[latitude, longitude]` in `metadata.json`.

## HTTPS uploads

- Automatic upload is opt-in. Manual upload remains available. Successful upload keeps the original on the watch.
- Retryable failures defer the note for five minutes. Permanently rejected notes are skipped by automatic upload.
- After the app closes, Garmin schedules background jobs at a requested five-minute interval. Jobs checkpoint acknowledged chunks and stop starting requests after 20 seconds.
- The receiver accepts one token, up to 40 MB and 10,000 chunks per note, and about 1 GB of stored data. It validates the container header and chunk set and keeps the original audio bytes.

For phone transfers and their size limit, see the [Android beta guide](android-beta.qmd).
